newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end slightly lower, Colruyt up.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end slightly lower, Colruyt up.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Belgian shares closed slightly lower Thursday after trading within tight range ahead of Friday's reweighting of the Bel-20 index. * Bel-20 index .BFX ended 3.78 points down at 1,750.87 after opening at 1,755.59. * Tractebel unchanged at 14,800 francs after surging five percent on Wednesday on news of SGB bid. * Colruyt up 200 francs to 11,500 on news of 12 percent rise in earnings.
* Fast food chain Quick down 30 francs to 2,380 after rising earlier in the day to 2,520.
